text:
lina: Quick tarmac sync for GA. Need final decisions: SLA wording (maintenance + cross-region fallback), docs publish, pricing caps, oncall plan. Can each owner confirm by Thu EOD?
tom: Perf update: baseline p95=85ms, p99=470ms. Recommend SLA targets: p95<=120ms, p99<=500ms. Note: cross-region failover not covered by primary SLA.
sohail: SRE can sign 99.9% uptime for the public API if we carve out scheduled maintenance window and emergency mitigation clauses. Error budget alerts: notify at 30% burn, page at 60%.
irene: Docs: GA playbook draft is up. Missing 1) legal SLA paragraph, 2) pricing table text, 3) canned support replies. Will hold publish until those arrive.
karen: Finance: propose default per-account burst cap + soft-warning at 75% usage and a hard cap enforced at 150% by default. Enterprise customers can opt for higher caps via contract. Need copy for pricing page.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Preflight checks passed: smoke tests, canary OK at 7% traffic for 45m.
lina: Rollout plan: 7% -> 25% -> 60% -> 100%, 1h stability gates. Auto-rollback triggers: >1% absolute error increase OR p95 > 2x baseline.
tom: I'll add runbook_url field to alerts and enable synthetic probes for /health, /predict every 90s.
sohail: I'll draft the maintenance notice language and SLA exception section and send to Legal. ETA Wed EOD.
irene: I'll add a "cost controls" subsection to docs with snippet: ```Quotas & caps: set per-project limits, enable alerts at 75% and billing safety cap at 150%```
lina: Action owners: Legal SLA text (Legal, cc @sohail) Wed EOD; Pricing copy (karen) Thu 12:00; Docs publish (irene) Thu 18:00; SRE policy (sohail) Thu EOD. If everyone hits these, locking GA for Mon 14:30 UTC. Any objections?
karen: No objections. I'll circulate pricing copy by Thu noon.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Reminder: tag runbook links in alerts before GA.
